text.en: The best vegan sweets I've had in all of Japan. The soy soft serve is unbelievably creamy — I went back three times during my trip!
text.ko: 일본 전체를 통틀어 최고의 비건 디저트였어요. 소이 소프트 아이스크림의 크리미함이 믿을 수 없을 정도! 여행 중 세 번이나 다시 갔어요!
text.zh-cn: 在整个日本吃过最好的纯素甜点。豆奶冰淇淋的丝滑口感令人难以置信——旅途中我去了三次！
text.zh-tw: 在整個日本吃過最好的純素甜點。豆奶冰淇淋的絲滑口感令人難以置信——旅途中我去了三次！

text.en: As someone with celiac disease, traveling in Japan was terrifying. SoyStories was my safe haven. The donuts are incredible and the staff made me feel so welcome.
text.ko: 셀리악병이 있어서 일본 여행이 무서웠는데, SoyStories는 저의 안식처였어요. 도넛이 정말 놀라워요.
text.zh-cn: 作为一个有乳糜泻的人，在日本旅行很可怕。SoyStories是我的避风港。甜甜圈太棒了。
text.zh-tw: 作為一個有乳糜瀉的人，在日本旅行很可怕。SoyStories是我的避風港。甜甜圈太棒了。

text.en: If you are looking for an incredible sweet treat, this plant-based and gluten-free cafe is absolutely worth seeking out! They specialize in soy milk and rice flour sweets that taste completely indulgent.Whether you follow a strict vegan diet or just love a good dessert, you will absolutely fall in love with their waffles and ice cream combinations. The waffle and pure soy milk soft serve is particularly delicious, offering the perfect balance of warmth and creaminess. On top of the amazing food, ordering is a breeze thanks to their convenient English menu. They also have great takeout options if you want to enjoy your treats on the go. The staff here is incredibly courteous and helpful, making the whole experience even better!

This place is such a treat to people who is vegan and want healthy - sweet dessert.
I was so grateful for their purpose 'To give form to the happiness of eating together' Because that was what I was craving as vegan. To have togetherness.

I had gluten free, Sugar free, Gluten free dessert here and It was so flavorful, Chewy and yumemitai!
Ice cream tasted like mildly sweet, soft, mid tofu soy taste which I adored it.
Honestly that bread that covers the soft icecream is a gem because it is so crispy but gooey and soft inside that it has such a harmony.

I highly recommend it!!! 🪽🧑‍🩰

* I asked for sustainable fork instead of plastic!

Oh this was such an AMAZING TREAT!!! I have celiac and came here with my husband and son who are not. We all enjoyed the bubble waffles, soy ice cream, dorayaki & donuts ALOT!!!! You would never know the ice cream was dairy free with how creamy it was & the flavors were outstanding. The black sesame was a big hit but the strawberry and chocolate also delivered big on flavor. We are only in Fukuoka for 2 days but we are tempted to go again before we leave. It's that good! Worth the taxi ride for sure!

Excelent soft serve soy icecream with crispy waffle, ordered large with a coffee on the side to complement. This is not your typical western bland soy flavored ice-cream. This place takes it to another level.
Very flavorful and delicious texture coupled with the crispy made to order waffle, I felt I was in heaven. Then to top it off they give you a tray of varies toppings to try.

Ordered two donuts to go a strawberry 🍓 and mint flavor have not tried yet but will do latter with some green sencha tea.

The lady behind the counter did speak English,  she was a sweethart.

Definitely will come here again before I leave the area!

The owner was so lovely, knowledgeable and the ice cream and bubble waffle was exceptional. The best I’ve ever had. It tastes better than any dairy treats I’ve had all over the world. I highly recommend the black sesame waffle- you can see the black sesame seeds! The matcha ice cream is also so rich in flavour.  Very good pricing too. COME HERE 🫶🏻
